source.title: Terror of the Desert Skies
source.description: The drawing is composed of rough, broad, strokes and seems to depict a large bird of prey. Despite the simple composition, the artist clearly viewed this creature with fear and awe. An expert on big game could likely tell you more.
source.objective: Bring the Primitive Drawing to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
source.completion: Well now. This is certainly interesting...
